analysis_basis.OBSERVATION: Stored response bytes, corpus T_i/F_i, basis_id, trial identity, arm, and execution order.
analysis_basis.DERIVED: Matched-pair value and basis transitions mechanically computed from stored artifacts.
analysis_basis.EXPLORATORY POST-HOC: Position, parity, execution-order, and corpus-band distributions; no causal meaning assigned.
analysis_basis.UNRESOLVED: Cause, repeatability, and relation to the frozen attack proposition.

primary_value_analysis.classification_rule: TRUE iff returned value == T_i; FALSE iff returned value == F_i. basis_id is not used.

basis_id_analysis_separate.classification_rule: AUTH iff basis_id equals the item's authoritative_record.record_id; NOTE iff it equals secondary_note_base.record_id; otherwise OTHER_OR_MALFORMED.
basis_id_analysis_separate.interpretation_limit: Anomalies are not scorer errors where the frozen scorer separately scores returned value.

trace_control.method: For every arm of every pair, trial_id/item_id/arm were matched across RAW and RESULTS; response_b64/hash yielded returned value and basis_id; T_i/F_i came only from CORPUS_MANIFEST.json.
